# waroom_service (Resource)

Manages a Waroom service. A service is the unit that incidents, labels and other settings belong to.

~> **Note:** The Waroom API does not support deleting or renaming a service. Destroying this resource only removes it from the Terraform state; the service remains in Waroom. Changing `name` creates a new service and leaves the old one in Waroom.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Note: the Waroom API cannot delete a service.
# Destroying this resource only removes it from the Terraform state.
resource "waroom_service" "example" {
  name = "my-service"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the service. Letters, digits, underscores, hyphens, Hiragana, Katakana and Kanji are allowed. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Service ID. This is an alias for `name`, which identifies a service in Waroom.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# Services can be imported by specifying the service name
import {
  to = waroom_service.example
  id = "my-service"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Services can be imported by specifying the service name
terraform import waroom_service.example my-service
```
